errors.description: The drawing depicts the placket closed - a single straight vertical fold edge with the knot positions carried only as red notation behind it. The photograph shows the covering flap turned back and open so the knots are exposed, which introduces a diagonal opening edge not present in the closed drawing. This is the state the option description explicitly calls for ('visible when the flap is opened') and is required for the knots to be identifiable at all, so it is recorded rather than treated as a geometry failure.
errors.expected: closed vertical fold edge exactly as drawn
errors.actual: flap turned back to the wearer's left, exposing the knot column; opening edge runs slightly diagonal at the top
